# Engine test fixtures

Generated by `scripts/make-fixtures.sh` (needs ffmpeg) and **git-ignored**. They total well over
5 MB, so the script is the source of truth. Each `<name>.m4a` has a `<name>.f32` reference:
ffmpeg's own decode, interleaved float32 little-endian, with the edit list applied.

`test/decoder.test.mjs` compares the WASM decoder against the references, and
`test/mp4samples.test.mjs` demuxes every fixture. Both skip the fixture checks when this folder
has no fixtures. Tests that need no ffmpeg build their MP4s in memory (`test/helpers/`).
